structured.answer: I haven't decided anything. I'll ask you or the bank. The page shows Harel has a huge number of tracks, about 0.4% to 0.67% a year in fees taken "מהחיסכון", and the ones called "כספי (שקלי)" look the calmest at about 4.4% a year over 3 years. But I couldn't tell which one is as safe as my deposit, so I won't move anything.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of product buttons ('כל המוצרים 105', 'קופת גמל להשקעה', 'קרן השתלמות'…)
stuck.why: I didn't know which of these was meant for someone like me with savings, and none of them says 'פיקדון' or 'חיסכון בטוח'. So I just started reading the list from the top.

stuck.where: Column 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול'
stuck.why: Many tracks say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' where a number should be. I wasn't sure if that means the track is new or something else, so I couldn't compare those tracks at all.
I don't understand why there are two fees, or why in 'קרן חדשה מקיפה' the second one is 1.47%. That's higher than everything else, and it worried me.

stuck.where: Screen 4, after the long list of pension funds
stuck.why: It's the same rows of numbers over and over. I got tired and stopped there without reaching the end.

used: The title 'הראל' and the line under it saying the fees are what was actually collected in 2025, from 'רשות שוק ההון' data
The group headers, e.g. 'קופת גמל להשקעה · 16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'
The rows 'כספי (שקלי)' (3 years 4.25%, 5 years 3.08%; another 4.4%) and 'אג"ח סחיר' (0% מניות)
The fee numbers 'מהחיסכון' in each row
skimmed: The rows with מניות / S&P 500 / עוקב מדד. I only saw that they have high returns like 13.7% and 21%
The 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' and 'חיסכון לכל ילד' sections. I only noticed the 0.01% fee in 'חיסכון לכל ילד' and thought of the grandchildren
skipped: The coloured circles next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח'
The small arrows at the left end of each row
The question-mark icons next to the column headings
unsure_meaning: סחיר (in 'אג"ח סחיר'). Are these the safe government bonds?
תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול: is 4.25% for each year or for all three years?
קרן חדשה מקיפה / קרן חדשה כללית / תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים
The dotted underline under the numbers
not_found: Anything about פיקדון or a comparison with a bank deposit
A sentence saying which track is safe or carries no risk
Losses or bad years (I didn't see a minus anywhere, so I don't know if there were any)
A plain explanation of which product is meant for a retiree's savings

findings.what: Black background, small grey writing and lots of numbers in every row. It made me anxious, and with my glasses on I could barely read the small words like 'החיסכון' and 'שנים'
It opens straight into tracks with 'מניות' and 'S&P 500' and percentages. There's no word about safety or deposits, and I felt it wasn't meant for me
Many tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so there's nothing to compare
findings.where: The return column on all screens

findings.what: Two fees per row with no explanation, and a 1.47% 'מההפקדות' fee in the pension fund that scared me
Very long rows: from the track name on the right to the money amount on the left I lose the line in the middle
Circles in yellow and turquoise that look alike to me, with no sentence saying what they mean
Too long: the same tracks (מניות, כללי, אג"ח סחיר) repeat in every product, and I got lost over which one I was looking at
